title: Venezuelan Airy Bread
description: A traditional Venezuelan flatbread with crispy edges and airy interior. Serve with your favorite fillings.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine yeast and warm water. Let it sit for 5 minutes.
2. Add flour, salt, and mix until a dough forms.
4. Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
5. Preheat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium-high heat.
6. Divide the dough into 2-3 equal portions, depending on the desired size.
7. Roll out each portion into a thin circle.
8. Cook each bread for 1-2 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
9. If desired, cook a pita in the same pan for an additional minute on each side.
